<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update sys_domain="global" table="sys_script"><sys_script action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><abort_action>false</abort_action><access>package_private</access><action_delete>false</action_delete><action_insert>true</action_insert><action_query>false</action_query><action_update>true</action_update><active>true</active><add_message>false</add_message><advanced>true</advanced><change_fields>false</change_fields><client_callable>false</client_callable><collection>x_1929776_compli_0_control</collection><condition/><description/><execute_function>false</execute_function><filter_condition/><is_rest>false</is_rest><message/><name>Reject validity periods shorter than</name><order>100</order><priority>100</priority><rest_method/><rest_method_text/><rest_service/><rest_service_text/><rest_variables/><role_conditions/><script><![CDATA[// Role: refuses a control whose validity is shorter than the warning window.
//       Otherwise a freshly approved proof would already be "expiring" on the day it is approved.
(function executeRule(current, previous) {
  var warning = new CPMUtil().intProp('warning_days', 30);
  if (parseInt(current.getValue('validity_days'), 10) <= warning) {
    gs.addErrorMessage('Validity days must be greater than the ' + warning + '-day warning window.');
    current.setAbortAction(true);
  }
})(current, previous);]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-10-21 22:54:09</sys_created_on><sys_domain>global</sys_domain><sys_domain_path>/</sys_domain_path><sys_id>56a27d0a7300d310a621f2024ab8b76e</sys_id><sys_mod_count>8</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Reject validity periods shorter than</sys_name><sys_overrides/><sys_package display_value="Compliance Posture Mapper" source="x_1929776_compli_0">f7756d0a738c9310a621f2024ab8b707</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Compliance Posture Mapper">f7756d0a738c9310a621f2024ab8b707</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_56a27d0a7300d310a621f2024ab8b76e</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-10-29 23:05:26</sys_updated_on><template/><when>before</when></sys_script><sys_translated_text action="delete_multiple" query="documentkey=56a27d0a7300d310a621f2024ab8b76e"/></record_update>
